data.one_liner: A Material Design 3 floating pill-style toolbar widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable floating toolbar widget supporting horizontal and vertical layouts, Material Design 3 color variants, icon and label action buttons, selected states, and optional FloatingActionButton integration.
use_when: You need a Material Design 3 floating action toolbar or pill toolbar in your Flutter app.
You want to display icon-only, label-only, or combined buttons with built-in accessibility features.
avoid_when: You are building a standard top app bar or bottom navigation bar rather than a floating toolbar component.
strengths: Supports Material Design 3 specs including automatic theming, touch targets, and elevation.
Offers both horizontal and vertical layouts with optional FloatingActionButton integration.
Provides built-in accessibility with semantic labels and tooltips.
weaknesses: Limited to Material Design 3 floating toolbar patterns.
data.minimal_example:
M3FloatingToolbar(
  actions: [
    M3FloatingToolbarAction(
      icon: Icons.home,
      semanticLabel: 'Home',
      tooltip: 'Home',
      onPressed: () => print('Home pressed'),
    ),
    M3FloatingToolbarAction(
      icon: Icons.explore,
      semanticLabel: 'Explore',
      tooltip: 'Explore',
      onPressed: () => print('Explore pressed'),
    ),
  ],
)
